Subject: Avalon Labs — technical recap & mutual action plan

Hi Sasha / Ava —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. I captured the key pain points, target SLOs, and what we discussed for the POC topology.

Recap (high level)
- Primary pain: unpredictable inference cost and tail latency during peak authentication flows (30–45s bursts).
- Goal: consistent 99th-percentile latency <= 120ms for typical 512-token responses, sustainable cost per 1k tokens under your budget threshold (we discussed ~$0.30/1k as a target).
- Scale: baseline steady-state 20 QPS, peak 85 QPS (5–10 minute bursts), typical sequence length 350 tokens.

Technical requirements we noted
- Model: preference for open 13B-class (quantized) — you mentioned evals vs L2-13B; Redwood supports Llama-derivative and smaller variants.
- Topology: hybrid routing (primary hosted in us-west + dedicated VPC nodes for sensitive routes).
- Security: SOC 2 + VPC peering and customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest.
- Caching: prefix KV caching for repeated auth prompts to reduce token costs.

Proposed POC scope (what Redwood will run)
1) Baseline perf run: run 1h steady-state (20 QPS) + 10m burst run to 90 QPS to validate 99p latency and token cost.
2) Model profile: test L2-13B quantized + a 7B variant for fallback routing.
3) Observability: share perf dashboards (latency heatmaps, per-route cost) and an SLO dashboard link.
4) Security handoff: provide SOC 2 report & ship the minimal onboarding docs for VPC/KMS.

Immediate next steps (actions & owners)
- Avalon: share representative payloads, authentication call patterns, and a sample of 2000 anonymized requests (Ava) — due: Nov 12.
- Redwood (Marissa): spin up POC infra and validate burst run; share initial perf run by Nov 14.
- Redwood (Priyom): produce minimal mutual action plan and procurement checklist (attached).

Attachments I’ve dropped into the Drive link below: Avalon_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (POC milestones) and poc-checklist.pdf (procurement + security handshake).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBPOC-ExampleLink
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/AVLN-72

If that looks right I’ll schedule the perf run for next Wednesday (Nov 13) or Thursday (Nov 14) — please indicate preferred day/time.

Thanks —
Ethan

Thanks Ethan — this is very helpful and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Payloads: we can share sanitized logs and 2k sample requests by EOD Nov 11. They include a mix of short and long prompts — expect ~20% > 700 tokens.
2) Security: SOC 2 Type II is required for our SOC team; can you also provide an exportable audit-log sample (anonymized)?
3) SLA/Procurement timing: procurement will need pricing + an MSA; we’re targeting an internal sign-off window by end of December.

One ask on SLOs — our product lead asked if Redwood can demonstrate 99p latency for both 512- and 1024-token sequences during the burst test. We’re flexible on the cost target if we can guarantee latency.

Preferred POC dates: Nov 14 morning PT or Nov 15 earliest window.

Sasha

Thanks Sasha — appreciate the clarifications and the flexibility on cost. Confirming next items and a slightly adjusted test plan to cover both 512 and 1024 sequences during burst: 

Adjusted POC test plan
- Phase A: 1h steady-state at 20 QPS with mixed token distribution.
- Phase B: 15m burst to 90 QPS with two 7.5m windows: first window samples ~512-token sequences, second window samples ~1024-token sequences.
- Metrics to capture: p50/p95/p99 latency, CPU/GPU utilization, per-route token cost, error rates.

Action owners & timelines
- Avalon (Ava): share 2k sanitized requests + security contact for SOC artifacts by Nov 11.
- Redwood (Marissa): infra ready + perf dashboards live by Nov 13.
- Redwood (Priyom): send MSA + pricing ballpark for POC and 12-week pilot by Nov 12.

Scheduling: we’ll reserve Nov 14 09:00–11:00 PT for Phase A + an initial ramp; Phase B burst run will follow at ~10:30 PT if you’re ok. If Nov 14 morning doesn’t work we can move to Nov 15 07:30–09:30 PT. Please confirm.
